# TaskFlow — Project Management SaaS

## Goals
- Build a web-based project management tool
- Support team collaboration with real-time updates
- Integrate with GitHub for issue tracking
- Provide a REST API for third-party integrations

## User Stories
- As a project manager, I can create and assign tasks to team members
- As a developer, I can link GitHub PRs to tasks
- As a team lead, I can view progress dashboards
- As an admin, I can manage team permissions

## Stakeholders
- Product team
- Engineering team
- Design team

## Tech Stack
- React frontend with Next.js
- Node backend with REST API
- Postgres database
- Redis for caching
- Docker for containerization

## Timeline
3 months
